messages:
Riley Adams: Need a snappier battlecard for field team. Current doc too verbose. Can we compress to 3 bullets + 2 rebut lines vs infra vendors?
Nora Patel: Yup. Proposed bullets: 1) unified API across environments, 2) predictable SLOs + routing, 3) cost controls (batching + caching).
Gabe Flores: Rebut lines: 
- Infra vendor: "We can host ourselves." Reply: "You can, but Redwood gives production-grade autoscaling, routing policies, and observability out of the box."
- Infra vendor: "We'll manage latency with custom infra." Reply: "Our kernels, batching and KV cache are built for inference production specifically; less ops churn."
bench-bot: latest-bench: 2025-07-12 | sample-chat: redwood 95p=115ms, infraX 95p=182ms. See CSV.
legal: flagged phrasing: add hardware parity note and bench appendix link.
Riley Adams: Great. Nora, compress into one-pager and drop into #sales-ready by 3pm. Gabe, can you give 2 quick demos to SAs next week?
Nora Patel: Will do.
Gabe Flores: yes scheduling.
Riley Adams: Thanks.
